reading.title: How Scientists Think
reading.purpose: Learn the thinking steps scientists use.
paras: Scientists notice things around them. They wonder why. They guess and predict what will happen.
Then they decide how to test the idea. After a test, they may realize something new. Now they understand more. They believe an answer when the test shows it.

choices: say what you think will happen next.
qs.why: Scientists predict what will happen before they test.

qs.q: What do scientists do after they predict?
choices: Decide how to test the idea.
qs.why: The reading says they decide how to test the idea.

qs.q: When do scientists believe an answer?
qs.why: The reading says they believe an answer when the test shows it.
